goal: Set the gold each dungeon kind pays, in line with today's stop and raid purses

extra_axes.name: economy
extra_axes.why: the goal is gold amounts: what a run pays against what else pays, and what can be farmed
extra_axes.ruling_why: every claim on the purses lands here, and device, time and tokens do not move with a number in a table

claims.text: Stop purses today, rolled once per winner: type trainer and grunt 5k to 15k, gym 20k to 50k, ace trainer 25k to 60k, executive 40k to 90k, elite 50k to 110k, Giovanni 120k to 250k, Champion 150k to 300k (a legend seat 250k to 500k), Frontier Brain 200k to 400k
Raid purses are flat: Shadow 35k, Totem, Max, Alpha and Tera 50k, Noble 55k, Legendary 80k, Mythical 200k
Raids and NPC stops turn over every 3 hours, the window a dungeon run is cleared once in

Shop prices are small beside the purses: 243 priced items, median 3,000, 90th percentile 10,000, highest 29,400. Full Restore 3,000, Max Revive 4,000, machines 2,000 to 12,000, NPC fees 2,500 to 5,000

evidence.source: buy: fields in src/data/items/records/*.yaml; src/data/items/machines.ts; src/data/overworld/npc.ts

claims.text: A trade carries at most 1,000,000 gold, so between players gold is worth what other players sell for it
Every purse goes through checkGoldReward, which a buddy's Luck Incense doubles, so any per-fight purse doubles with it
PR #141 paid a hideout 120k to 250k, a lair 80k and a Frontier 200k to 400k on the clear alone, nothing per fight

evidence.detail: the earlier build's 'What clearing pays' table; it was never played, so it says nothing about how the numbers felt

claims.text: Each fight in a run pays the stop purse of the same foe from J1, and the end of the run pays its boss's purse. A dungeon fight is then worth what the same fight is worth on the map, and the run is worth its fights
Lair hordes have no stop band, so a horde pays 10k to 25k (between a grunt and an ace), the stairs' horde 25k to 60k, and the legendary at the end 80k, the Legendary raid's purse
Endless Stair floors pay per floor, rising with the floor, so a long climb pays most
claims.ruling_why: O2 holds: the Stair has no window, so per-floor gold is farmed without limit

claims.text: Companion Trail trainers pay half the type-trainer band, 2,500 to 7,500, since the partner fights beside the player and heals them
One flat purse per kind on the clear, as raids and PR #141 do, and nothing per fight
claims.ruling_why: O3 holds: a failed run then pays nothing, and the deeper floors a player did reach count for nothing

claims.text: Summing fights makes a 5-floor hideout pay about 610k on average, over 3 times a Giovanni stop (185k mean), which floods gold into trades capped at 1M

evidence.source: 5 floors x (2 grunts at 10k + an executive at 65k) + 185k, from J1

claims.ruling_why: true, and low in effect: per fight the pay is the stop's own, and a run is 15 or more fights with a locked party and no Nurse Joy. Kept by capping rooms at 2 paying fights a floor

claims.text: The Endless Stair can be started at any time (decided in dungeons.md). Per-floor gold lets a player farm its easy first floors over and over with no window to stop them
With gold only on the clear, losing on the last floor pays nothing for every fight before it, while a stop pays each fight as it is won

evidence.source: src/server/stops.ts:648-695 pays on the first claim of each stop

claims.text: A failed run restarts from floor 1 in the same window. If each fight pays on every attempt, losing on purpose and refighting the first floor's grunts farms gold

claims.why: O4: restarts in the same window would pay the same fights again
claims.text: Each fight pays once per window, keyed like a stop's purse by the dungeon, the window, the floor, the room and the player. A restarted run refights for nothing it was already paid

claims.why: O2: no window bounds the Stair
claims.text: The Stair pays no gold per floor. Each 8th floor pays once per account, the first time the player reaches it: 2,500 gold times the floor number, so 20k at floor 8 and 200k at floor 80
A run burns the player's own medicine, about 5 to 10 Full Restores or Max Revives on a hard run, 15k to 40k gold, so the purse is partly a refund
claims.ruling_why: a reason the sums in O1 are not a windfall, not a reason to change them
